description: This file defines API endpoints for role adjacency operations, such as suggesting adjacent roles and providing detailed comparisons. It integrates with an external role mapping service with fallback logic to local database computations. Includes route handlers, database helper functions, and response schemas.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _required_map_by_role_id(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches required competency levels per role ID from the database.

methods.name: float _weighted_jaccard(map_a: Dict[str, int], map_b: Dict[str, int])
methods.description: Calculates the weighted Jaccard similarity between two competency mappings.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse _local_adjacent_roles( db: Session, role_name: str, limit: int, min_score: float )
methods.description: Computes suggested adjacent roles from local DB data as a fallback.

methods.name: AdjacencyDetailsResponse _local_adjacency_details( db: Session, current_role: str, target_role: str )
methods.description: Provides detailed adjacency information between two roles from local DB data as a fallback.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse get_role_adjacency( role: str = Query(..., description="Role name (or numeric ID as a fallback)"), limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=50, description="Maximum results to return"), min_score: float = Query(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Minimum similarity score threshold"), _: object = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

AdjacencyDetailsResponse get_role_adjacency_details( current_role: str = Query(..., description="Current role name"), target_role: str = Query(..., description="Target role name"), _: object = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
